nom: Lancôme UV Expert Defense SPF 50+ Primer & Moisturizer

avis.titre: The only face sunsreen I LOVE
avis.texte: I am 48, and I still have the oily skin of a teenager. This is the ONLY sunscreen I have found that doesn't feel heavy, smelly and oily. It's expensive, but it is the one product I can't live withouth. My dermatologist thanks me.
This product is fine but it doesnt leave my skin looking particularly great. So, there isnt much value for me with this product.

I bought this when it was on sale (thankfully) after reading all of the amazing reviews. I'm glad that it works well on so many others, but unfortunately, my experience with this primer has been nothing short of frustrating. For reference, I'm 4W1 in Estee Lauder's Double Wear foundation. I've worn this alone as a sunscreen, which results in it forming white streaks on my neck and around my nose and lips, which looks quite disgusting. When worn under makeup, it starts to pill, resulting in me wasting the last half hour of my life prepping my skin for foundation since I have to take it off and start all over again. I'd suggest that people try it on in the store and see how it wears or wait for it to be on sale like I did (even then, it's not worth it, in my opinion).
I love it every time I put it on. It feels silky and luxurious, absorbs quickly and leaves a glowy finish. It's a primer with sunscreen so has a very small whitecast but not visible under makeup.

I had high hopes for this product, but unfortunately, it was a major letdown. For the price, you don't get enough product, and the formula is just not it—especially for brown skin. It left a noticeable white cast and made me look gray and oily throughout the day. Even when I skip makeup, it still PILLS!!!, which is incredibly frustrating. I really wanted to like this, but it's just not working for me. Is it just me, or is this a common issue? Either way, I can't recommend it.

avis.titre: Decent but can't get past the scent
avis.texte: I know fragrance is not good for us but I tend to like scents. This one is just too much and too long. If Lancome had a frangrance-free option I would prefer it but returning because I can't get past the smell. Bought it during half off sale. I definitely wouldn't pay full price.

avis.titre: Not for brown or oily girlies
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this product but unfortunately it didn't work out for me. For reference I was in shade 420 N in their foundation. This product does indeed leave a white cast and makes me look grey. This product leaves me feeling very greasy and if you add even the slightest too much of the product it moves and disrupts foundation put on top of it. I don't ever mind the price of a product so long as it works and sunscreen is so important is good to invest on a product that's literally protecting you but this isn't it.
Bought this when on sales. Its the best combo sunscreen with vitamin, primer and sunscreen all in one. Love it!

This has way too much fragrance and smells like old lady perfume. Shame on me for not reading the ingredients, but not many of the recent reviews mention a strong perfume scent. But if you look at them, it has added fragrance. The sunscreen itself is ok, but I wouldn't call it lightweight. It's definitely a thicker moisturizer/sunscreen and probably best suited for dry skin. My combo skin wasn't overly greasy, but for me it is just too heavy for daytime use. Also, It didn't do anything to help my makeup look better or last, so not that great as a primer. I got it during the 21 days of beauty, and even at half price, it's way too much for this product. Other than vitamin E, there are no real skincare benefits in it. There are so many better sunscreens. I hate waste so I'll probably continue to use it as a body sunscreen. But with all the fragrance it's not going anywhere near my face.

This was recommended to me by a store associate, I was looking for a SPF with moisturizer, so I purchased it and I absolutely love it. It leaves my skin feeling silky and my foundation application goes on smoothly. I've gotten great compliments indicating my makeup looks great when wearing this underneath. First time user and will keep this as my staple.

Every once in awhile a sunscreen will slightly burn my eyes. When I used this product for the first time, the burning of a thousand suns hit me and I had to remove my contacts and wash my face (not ideal when trying to get to work). My eyes burned most of the day and were sensitive to light. It took an hour before I could drive to work and even then they were still tearing up badly.

avis.titre: Good on its own, not with makeup
avis.texte: This product is good when worn on its own (maybe with a light layer of powder) and gives a nice glow to the skin. I tried to wear it under makeup with different primers, liquid products and powder products, and it didn't fair too well; Always seemed to pill whether I used my fingers to blend, brushes, and even beauty blenders. I used it under water based and also oil based makeup and it seemed to break apart my makeup soon after for both. However as a sunscreen/SPF I can say it didn't sting my sensitive skin too much.
I can handle some fragrance. But this lasted forever i smelt it for hours after applying. The product itself is fine.

I love that is doesnt leave white cast as others, give me a glowy skin that looks like a new skin, is lightweight, leave super soft feeling, i'll look more specials in this product because definitely I will keep it as my daily. I hadn't dull skin i was just making cheapest decisions.

I have used this product for years, now. I hate SPF and this one is perfect because it's also a primer. My makeup lasts longer when I have this one. It has gone up in price. I have bought other brands of spf for my face but end up coming back to this one.
Moisturizing non greasy sunscreen product. A little goes a long way.

I have oily skin and finding an everyday face sunscreen has been a nightmare. This is the best product I have found so far. Goes on easy, absorbs and doesn't leave a sunscreen residue. Leaves my face feeling soft and make up goes on easy after. Bonus for smelling good!!! Not a lot of product for the prices is the only downside.
My dermotologist has not needed to treat as many pre-cancer spots on my face since using this product.
This product burned the skin under my eyes creating blisters. I have never had this problem and I d not have sensitive skin.

I love this sunscreen because I have oily/sensitive/acne prone skin and this sunscreen works well with my skin. It is a small tube but I love it and the ingredients are excellent they are noncomedogenic! Lovely sunscreen :) Thank you so much Lancome !

avis.titre: Does the job but so much money for little product
avis.texte: I wish for the money this cost that it wikld have more product.
Great product for moisturizer and sunscreen. Only takes a small amount, and very moisturizing

avis.titre: Like the idea of this combo!
avis.texte: This is my 1st time with this product and so far so good. I use it under my Lancome Foundation and wait 5mins between application. It has a suncreen aroma but it is very light aroma. Works well with the foundation.
My skin routine completely changed after using this sunscreen ♥️ It's lightweight eight and my makeup stays in-place longer. Very happy with this product.

I tried this moisturizer because it has good sun protection, here in Az, it is demanding to protect your skin. I loved. But I must be honest, my skin type is combination oily, and every time I use it my skin becomes even oilier, more shiny than normal. but I loved using it under makeup because it fits perfectly. thank you!
It is good and effective But if you want to apply proper amount of it is shiny on my face
This product provides excellent protection from the strong summer sun. It also goes on smoothly, has a lovely silky quality, and absorbs quickly.
My skin is very sensitive. I tried to use many of sunblock suff. Finally I decided to use the Lancome one.

This is hands down my favorite SPF Suncreen and Makeup Primer. I love how hydrating it is and mixes well with my moisturizer. On makeup free days, it gives my skin a beautiful subtle glow. So excited this is now in a larger size for a great price!

I receive compliments on my makeup all of the time since I started using this primer. It leaves a shine on my face & people like it. I like how it blends well with my makeup. I'm going to keep buying it.

avis.titre: Used to replace my discontinued Bienfait Moisturiz
avis.texte: I am so disappointed that Lancome discontinued their Bienfait SP15,moisturizer in the pump! I needed something to replace it and this was the closest I could find. Would prefer it to be unscented though.
It's the second time that I order Lancome defense SPF 50+ . It's not oily at all and works well.
After applying my skin just started shedding or pilling. I was hoping to use as sunscreen and primer before foundation.

While this spf works well, the size for price was too small. This bottle is extremely small. While the spf works well, I found it irritating if too close to the eyes. This product absorbs well and is non- greasy.
This is my go-to moisturizer with SPF. I really like the formula and that my foundation can be worn over top of it. The SPF seems to work well.

⁦ ⁦I like this product. it was so easy to apply. my face didn't feel greasy at all. it absorbs right into the skin. I like that its a 3 in 1 product. the primer is perfect. the spf 50 is awesome. I feel like my face is really protected. moisturizer is a bonus in that it makes my face smooth.
This is a wonderful addition to makeup routine. Makeup stays on longer and sunscreen is a bonus. Great product
Favourite sunscreen of all time. Not oily or sticky at all, works really well as a makeup primer and any makeup you lay over this stays well.
I loved this primer and moisturizer!! It is very light, yet, provided excellent UV protection!
This wonderful, dual purpose SPF /primer is perfect!!! 10/10. After it is applied, no greasy or sticky feeling!!!
I love this primer/moisturizer. I've been using it for 3 years and will never use anything else. I love the way it makes my skin feel a little dewy and helps my powder make up stay!

avis.titre: Easy to use and not oily
avis.texte: I have used this for about one month. It is easy to apply and not oily
My Experiece with UV Expert is amazing!! i love it because where i live is very sunny and my skin don´t feel oil with it

Let me start by saying the formula itself is beautiful: lightweight, offers a healthy glow without looking greasy, smooths out texture, and plays nicely with my sensitive/rosacea-prone skin. I should be a big fan BUT… Why the heck does it smell like tires??! I've had it on for ~3 hrs and the rubbery smell still lingers. Hard pass!
I wear this every day. Bought it for my grandson for Marching Band
I love this primer. Use on a daily basis…skin feels so smooth and makeup so easy to apply.amu
It's so convenient and also keeps my make up in place all day.
I feel like I'm doing my best to take care of my face when I use SPF 50+ daily. After all, if I am going to invest in other serums to help my skin I need to try to keep sun damage at bay right?

I tried the new UV expert defense SPF 50 for the first time and was so very disappointed. The perspiration from my forehead made the product weep into my eyes and sting something fierce. If I use it I can only put it on beneath my eyes so that means my forehead and temples will not be protected. So disappointed and I love Lancome, but I cannot use this product.
Works well. It is less oily than most products on the market.
I like this sunscreen and have been using it for a long time. Not too oily.
Works great as a primer and is lightweight for a sunscreen. I have fair skin and work outside in the sun and the heat. Stays on all day and keeps my face from getting burned.
Light, effective, without no white trace. Good product, a bit pricy
Yevo años usando este primer con protector solar me gusta mucho lo uso con o sin maquillaje love it!!❤️
I love this product, however, it's very expensive and it goes really fast.
Great sunscreen. Perfect when under makeup. Very lightweight but moisturizes at the same time. Not oily which is what I look for.
This went on smoothly. Made my foundation look seamless. My skin looked less greasy throughout the day too. Wish the tube was bigger. But overall, this is a must try product.
The Tube was a lot smaller than I thought it would be. Did not last a very long time however, it did go on very smoothly.
I love this item. It's so light and smithy. Great for summer time.
It is smooth and easy to blend on my skin. It keeps my skin moisture all day.
I really love this primer & moisturizer with spf 50. I have been using it for years now, and just a must have for me

avis.titre: Perfect primer and moisturizer with spf.
avis.texte: Love this two in one primer and moisturizer with spf. Smells great and is not sticky or tacky. Goes on smooth and helps lock in product.

I have used this product since it was recommended to me. I have extensive vitiligo & use this product everyday on my face & neck. It's a wonderful dual product…under makeup moisturizer & sunscreen. I'm often sensitive to many skin products & only use Lancome. I only wish that there was a larger tube available! I am also completely bald due to alopecia universalis.
I use this product every day. It is an excellent base for makeup and a superior sun protection. My daughter and i both use it daily and get many compliments on our skin.
This is a must have for summer. It's very light and won't be messy with any makeups. Easy to blend and no white residues,
Perfect primer. The UV protection is a plus. It seems like such a small amount for the money.
This sunscreen is my favorite facial sunscreen. I have oily/combination/sensitive skin, and this formula works extremely well.
I love the texture. It is not oily but moisturizing. It is perfect size for travel or gym bag.
Not sticky and feels natural on skin. Can be applied over foundation. Love it
The best sunscreen ever made! It works perfectly under the foundation. It blends perfectly!

After reading reviews about UV Expert Defense SPF 50+ Primer I was reluctant to try the new sunscreen that would replace Bienfiat Multi-Vital for me. I have normal skin so the cream does not feel greasy or heavy under makeup and the sunscreen protection appears to meet my expectations. The only negative is it is expensive for such a small volume.

Bought this as a substitute for renergie in a pump (discontinued) which I used as a replacement for Bienfet Total also discontinued.i am not sure if this is a moisturizer or sunscreen it is ok not as good as other products . Also the amount received for price is not great better off getting a drugstore moisturizer with SPF

Canvas ready. Painting a picture of beauty. Helps with fine lines

Product works well, and make up goes on top of if and stays. My complaint is that it is super expensive for the tiny tube you get so I will probably not repurchase.

The best thing you can do to protect your skin is to use sunscreen, and I love this one because it is not greasy, it blends into the skin, it hydrates, protects from the sun and makes your makeup last longer because it is also a primer. The only thing is that they should have various sizes.

This was my first time to order and utilize this product and I love it so much I will continue to purchase.

I have been using this sunscreen for more than 5 years. I love this product.
I like that it's three products in one, but I don't really like the finish
Feels a little heavy at the beginning, but once it settles in, It gives a beautiful glow. Must have for the summer!
Never used sunnyscream before until I found this, not oil or heavy.
Not greasy or thick. Glides on smooth, sets translucent, smooths pores, leaves skin nourished and radiant.
Love this product, works well as a primer for me, with a light moisturizer.
Lightweight, absorbs evenly, and easy to apply make-up on top of. Definitely a go to for that extra kick of SPF protection during the summer and great as an everyday moisturizer all through the year.
I love Sunscreen, UV expert is not heavy on the skin . It's like using primer and moisturizer at the same time. and SPF 50+
You can barely see or feel it after you apply. Great for my oily skin.

he probado protector solar y este no me deja la piel grasosa, plus contiene el primer que hace una buena mezcla.

Wow, can't say enough about this UV primer and moisturizer. It is exactly that! It has no terrible smell like most UV products and leaves my skis very soft. I use it every day and works wonderfully. This primer is the best and perfect for my skin for daily routine.

avis.titre: Must have in your make up bag

This sunscreen primer works well with and without foundation in our SW FL Sunshine. Highly recommend to protect from skin damage from the sun.
